home_meta_title: Independent Historic Motor Car Acquisition Advisory
home_meta_description: Independent advisory for collectors of historically significant motor cars. Research, provenance evaluation and acquisition advice across Europe and the United States.
home_subtitle: for Collectors of Historically Significant Motor Cars
home_advisory_p1: Every search begins with understanding the particular motor car you have in mind.
home_advisory_p2: I want to know what draws you to it: the model, the period, the coachwork or perhaps the history of an individual example. We discuss the provenance, originality, condition and restoration history you expect, together with how you intend to use the car.
home_advisory_p3: Your requirements guide my enquiries among owners, collectors and specialists across Europe and the United States. When a promising candidate emerges, I examine its history, documentation and individual characteristics to establish whether it deserves closer consideration.
home_advisory_p4: You can read more about my {#link}approach to research and assessment{/link}.
home_historical_significance_p1: The historical significance of a motor car arises from its individual history and characteristics.
home_historical_significance_p2: Provenance, rarity, coachwork, originality, preservation and associations with particular people or events may all contribute to its importance.
home_historical_significance_p3: Two examples of the same model can differ substantially in historical significance. Their individual histories and surviving characteristics deserve careful examination.
method_meta_title: Historic Motor Car Research, Provenance & Assessment
method_meta_description: Historic motor car research and assessment: provenance, documentary evidence, originality, restoration history and acquisition support.
method_mandate_p1: The starting point is the particular motor car you have in mind and the qualities that make it interesting to you.
method_mandate_p2: A maker and model give the search its broad outline. Period, coachwork, specification, provenance, originality and restoration history help define the individual example you are seeking.
method_mandate_p3: We discuss your expectations regarding condition and intended use, together with the geographical scope, timescale and financial parameters of the search.
method_mandate_p4: These requirements form the mandate and guide the assessment of each candidate.
method_research_p1: The search may lead through private owners, collectors, specialist dealers, marque clubs, restorers, auction offerings and historical archives.
method_research_p2: Depending on the motor car, I pursue enquiries through these sources and investigate leads arising from personal contacts.
method_research_p3: When a possible candidate emerges, I establish what can be learned about its history, specification and availability. The findings help us decide whether the car deserves closer examination.
method_evidence_p1: I examine the records associated with an individual motor car to establish its history and identity.
method_evidence_p2: Ownership and registration documents, period correspondence, photographs, invoices, coachbuilder records and restoration documentation can each contribute important information.
method_evidence_p3: I compare these sources, investigate discrepancies and consider how the surviving documentation relates to the motor car itself.
method_evidence_p4: Some conclusions can be firmly established through documentary evidence. Others depend on historical interpretation or require further investigation. I explain these distinctions and the significance of any remaining questions.
method_motor_car_p1: The motor car itself provides another source of historical evidence.
method_motor_car_p2: Its identity, surviving original components, coachwork, period specification, alterations and restoration history reveal how the individual car has developed over its lifetime.
method_motor_car_p3: I consider these characteristics alongside the documentation and examine how much of the car's historical character has survived.
method_motor_car_p4: Originality, preservation, restoration quality and mechanical condition each require careful consideration. Their importance also depends on the collector's expectations and intended use.
method_motor_car_p5: Where specialist technical examination is appropriate, I can coordinate an inspection and discuss the findings with you.
method_judgement_p1: My assessment brings together the motor car's history, its present condition, the available evidence and the requirements established in the collector's mandate.
method_judgement_p2: I explain the strengths of each promising candidate, the questions that deserve attention and the implications of the findings.
method_judgement_p3: The resulting recommendation may be to undertake further research, proceed to negotiations, reject the candidate or continue searching.
method_judgement_p4: I explain the reasons for my judgement so that you can decide how to proceed.
method_acquisition_p1: When you decide to pursue a particular motor car, I can assist with communication with its owner or seller, examination of additional records and coordination of specialist inspections.
method_acquisition_p2: My involvement may extend to negotiations, examination of acquisition documents and practical arrangements for transfer.
method_acquisition_p3: Throughout the process, I seek to clarify the material questions concerning the car and its acquisition, allowing you to make an informed decision.
method_acquisition_p4: We agree on the extent of my involvement according to the circumstances of the individual motor car.
method_acquisition_p5: You can {#link}make a private enquiry{/link} to discuss a possible engagement.
advisor_meta_title: Independent Historic Motor Car Advisor — Berlin
advisor_meta_description: Berlin-based independent advisor for collectors of historically significant motor cars. Provenance research, vehicle assessment and acquisition support across Europe and the United States.
advisor_profile_description: Meet Andrey Paymushin, an independent advisor based in Berlin, Germany, working with collectors across Europe and the United States.
advisor_p1: I am based in Berlin, Germany.
advisor_p2: My work brings me into contact with collectors, owners and specialists across Europe and the United States.
advisor_discretion_p1: I treat your enquiries, the details of your search, negotiations and acquisitions as confidential. The same discretion applies to an initial enquiry, before any formal engagement has begun.
advisor_discretion_p2: Before approaching an owner, seller or specialist, we agree what information about you and the motor car you are seeking may be disclosed. I share that information only with your express approval.
contact_meta_title: Private Enquiries — Historic Motor Car Advisory
contact_meta_description: Private enquiries concerning historically significant motor cars, including research, assessment and acquisition advice. Contact by email or telephone.
contact_confidentiality: I will treat your enquiry and any information you share with me in confidence.
imprint_meta_description: Legal information and contact details for Andrey Paymushin, providing research, assessment and acquisition advisory services for historically significant motor cars.
imprint_services_p1: I provide research, assessment and acquisition advisory services concerning historically significant motor cars.
imprint_services_p2: My remuneration may consist of fees paid by the collector, commissions paid by the seller, or both. Any seller commission or other economic interest connected with an acquisition will be disclosed to the collector.
privacy_meta_description: Information about personal data processing, website access, correspondence and your rights under the GDPR.
privacy_controller_p1: For enquiries concerning your personal data, please contact me at {#link}{email}{/link}.
privacy_access_p1: When you visit this website, your browser establishes a connection with the web server. Technical information, including your IP address and the requested resource, is processed to deliver the website to your device.
privacy_access_p2: This information is processed temporarily during the connection. The website does not maintain access logs or retain records of individual visits.
privacy_access_p3: The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. My legitimate interest is the reliable delivery and operation of the website.
privacy_technologies_p1: This website does not use cookies, analytics services, visitor tracking or advertising technologies.
privacy_communication_p1: When you contact me by email or telephone, I process the contact details and information you provide to respond to your enquiry and, where applicable, discuss or carry out an advisory engagement.
privacy_communication_p2: Where communication concerns a requested service or an existing contractual relationship, processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Other enquiries are processed under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, based on my legitimate interest in responding to correspondence.
privacy_communication_p3: You are under no obligation to contact me. If you do, I need sufficient contact information to respond to your enquiry.
privacy_services_p1: I use Gmail, a service provided by Google, to receive, send and store email correspondence.
privacy_services_p2: Correspondence processed through Gmail may be handled on Google's infrastructure outside the European Economic Area. Google describes its data processing and international transfer safeguards in its {#link}Privacy Policy{/link}.
privacy_disclosure_p1: An advisory engagement may require communication with motor-car owners, sellers, dealers, archives or independent specialists.
privacy_disclosure_p2: We will discuss what information about you and your requirements needs to be shared with these parties before making enquiries on your behalf. Depending on the engagement, recipients may be located in Europe or the United States.
privacy_retention_p1: I retain correspondence and related information for as long as necessary to handle your enquiry or carry out an advisory engagement.
privacy_retention_p2: Where statutory retention obligations apply, the relevant information is retained for the required period. Information may also need to be retained where necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
privacy_retention_p3: Otherwise, personal data is deleted when it is no longer required for the purpose for which it was collected.
privacy_rights_p1: Under the GDPR, you may have the right to request:
privacy_rights_objection: objection to processing based on legitimate interests.
privacy_rights_p2: You can exercise these rights by contacting me at {#link}{email}{/link}.
privacy_decisions_p1: No automated decision-making or profiling within the meaning of Article 22 GDPR is carried out in connection with website visits or enquiries.
privacy_complaints_p1: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
privacy_complaints_p2: The supervisory authority responsible for Berlin is the {#link}Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit{/link}.
